test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’

The police released a statement saying/, "This was one of the most vicious/attack we have ever seen."

options.text: The police released a statement saying,
"This was one of the most vicious

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4' **i.e.** 'attack we have ever seen.'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is incorrect because it** uses the singular form** *'attack' ***after the phrase*** 'one of the most vicious,' .*
 
• It should be followed by a **plural noun.** 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"This was one of the most vicious attacks we have ever seen."*
